source:
@@U01100@@
we'll waste not another moment. This very day I'll take you to her room.

@@U01102@@
Will I see her? Will I have her?

@@U01104@@
No! She'll be at a neighbor's. Meanwhile, all alone, you can bathe yourself in the aura of her fragrance, and feast on the promise of future joys.

@@U01106@@
Can we go now?

@@U01108@@
It’s still too soon.

@@U01110@@
Then find me some present to give her.

@@U01111@@
(Exit.)

@@U01113@@
Presents? So soon? Ah, well, that’s my boy! He'll succeed, no question about it! Besides, I know the location of many a buried treasure. Now for a bit of reconnoitering.

@@U01115@@
A neat, well-kept little room. 格蕾琴 braiding and binding up her hair.

@@U01117@@
Hm.
translation:
@@U01100@@
我们不会再浪费时间了。今天我会带你去她的房间。

@@U01102@@
我会见到她吗？我会拥有她吗？

@@U01104@@
不！她会去邻居家。与此同时，您可以独自沐浴在她芬芳的气息中，享受未来欢乐的希望。

@@U01106@@
我们现在可以走了吗？

@@U01108@@
现在还为时过早。

@@U01110@@
然后给我找一些礼物送给她。

@@U01111@@
（退出。）

@@U01113@@
礼物？这么快？啊，好吧，那是我的孩子！他一定会成功，这是毫无疑问的！此外，我还知道许多埋藏宝藏的位置。现在进行一些侦察。

@@U01115@@
一个整洁、维护良好的小房间。 格蕾琴正在编辫子并扎起头发。

@@U01117@@
嗯。
